wargear.name: Horsetail standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall pole hung with the manes of a hundred fallen rivals, which the unit follows as a banner and a challenge. Every model in the unit gains +1 Movement.

wargear.name: Stormcaller's totem
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bone and feather fetish, empty of any power until a Stormseer decides otherwise. The model gains +1 Willpower and +1 Cool.

rites.name: The Great Hunt
rites.flavor: The steppe has no fortresses. It has only prey that has not yet noticed it is being run down.
rites.text: Outrider Squadrons, Scimitar Jetbike Squadrons and Golden Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Every Cavalry unit gains Fast (1). The Hunt is cavalry and nothing else: no Terminator squads, no Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units. At least two Outrider, Scimitar or Keshig units are required.

require.note: Bring at least two cavalry squads.

rites.name: The Khagan's Own
rites.flavor: When the Khan's own riders and shadows take the line, the rest of the Legion simply follows.
rites.text: Golden Keshig and Ebon Keshig may fill Troops slots, cost 20 points less and gain Line (1) and +1 Leadership. The army must be led by the Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan. The levy is left behind: no Tactical, Despoiler, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads. At least two Keshig units are required.

require.note: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
Bring at least two Keshig units.

rites.name: Calling the Tempest
rites.flavor: The Stormseers raise their voices, and the sky answers in kind.
rites.text: Falcon's Claws may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Every Stormseer gains +1 Willpower and +1 Attack. The storm needs open sky and open ground: no Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units. At least two Stormseers are required.

rites.name: Dark Sons Descend
rites.flavor: No one remembers the Dark Sons' names. They like it that way, and so does the Khan.
rites.text: Dark Sons of Death may fill Troops slots, cost 25 points less and gain Line (1) and +1 Attack. The Dark Sons will not fight beside witchcraft: no Stormseers or other models with the Psyker Trait. At least two Dark Sons of Death squads are required.

require.note: Bring at least two Dark Sons of Death squads.
